description: This file contains source code related to Git's internal tree object handling. It includes functions for reading, parsing, comparing, and managing tree objects within a Git repository, as well as functions for traversing trees recursively.

classes.name: struct tree
classes.description: Represents a Git tree object, including its buffer, size, and object metadata.

classes.name: struct tree_desc
classes.description: Descriptor used for iterating over entries within a tree buffer.

classes.name: struct name_entry
classes.description: Represents an individual directory entry within a tree.

methods.name: int read_tree_at(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,int depth,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Recursively reads a tree at a given depth and applies a callback function to each entry.

methods.name: int read_tree(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Initializes and calls read_tree_at to perform a recursive read of a tree.

methods.name: int base_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Compares two names with consideration for directory modes.

methods.name: int df_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Provides a comparison similar to base_name_compare but treats directory and file conflicts as equal.

methods.name: int name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,const char * name2,size_t len2)
struct:tree * lookup_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Finds or creates a tree object given an object ID.

methods.name: int parse_tree_buffer(struct tree * item,void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Parses a tree object from a buffer.

methods.name: int parse_tree_gently(struct tree * item,int quiet_on_missing)
methods.description: Reads and parses a tree object, returning an error if not successful.

methods.name: void free_tree_buffer(struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Frees the buffer associated with a tree object.

methods.name: struct:tree * parse_tree_indirect(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Peels an object to a tree type given its object ID.
